notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Klauth or Soul of Windgrace.
Soul of Windgrace does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one land card in your graveyard.
description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least {7}{R/W}{R/W} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning a land card from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding a land card, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
